verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework that could plausibly ship messaging-channel adapters with inbound gating, so this axis applies. However, the evidence documents no sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating. Its input guardrails target prompt injection and sanitization, and AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS restricts model selection; both are adjacent controls, not sender gating.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
